visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Under H2 "All news": vertical list of articles in the main column, landscape thumbnail left, linked H3 title and short summary right; numbered square pagination buttons below (active page filled orange, others white with grey border, orange chevron next arrow).
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: Vertical paginated article list (image left, title + summary right); carousel-news is a horizontal carousel, cards-portrait a 3-up grid

contentPattern.summary: Repeating structured items (image + title + summary + link) with client-side pagination
contentPattern.structure: one row per article: [image | H3 title (linked), summary]

blockContent.description: Vertical list of 12 news articles, paginated 10 per page
rows: H3 title linked to article URL, summary paragraph

usage: Long list of news articles authored as one row per article (image, linked H3 title, summary). Shows 10 items per page with numbered page buttons and previous/next arrows when there are more than 10 rows.
reuseGuidance: Use for news or event archives. Each row is one article; link the title so the whole item becomes a link. Use carousel-news for a short featured strip of recent articles.
